bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'DEBUGAI_HTTP_AND_ROLE_SOURCE_CHECK\n'
docker exec debug-ai-debug-ai-1 node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs");const p="/app/server/main.js";console.log("APP_MAIN="+(fs.existsSync(p)?"PRESENT":"ALT_LAYOUT"));' >/dev/null
code=$(curl --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8787/health || true)
printf 'HTTP_8787_HEALTH_CODE=%s\n' "$code"
docker inspect debug-ai-debug-ai-1 --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep -q '^DEBUG_AI_ROLE_EXECUTION_MODE=six_role$' && { echo SIX_ROLE_ACTIVE; exit 0; }
echo SIX_ROLE_NOT_ACTIVE
exit 84
